description: Use this when the host gives the name their invite emails should carry, or when invite_participants reports host_name_needed. Do not use this to guess a name, to save a participant's or anyone else's name, to rename an interview, or to change the host's email address or other account details. Save the host's name: invite emails name the host by it, and replies go to the host's email address. Resolves the missing host name reported by invite_participants as host_name_needed, allowing an invitation preview. It sends nothing, saves only the name, leaves everything else on the account as it is, and needs no confirmation. Saving the same name again changes nothing.

name.description: The host's name, as the people they invite should see it. Example: Linh Do.

name: set_host_name
title: Set the host's name
